requested: implement a phase-neutral nominal dual-Reward gate while preserving FADA tensor compatibility
forbidden: new runner, network, adapter or backend API
simulation, training, server, Git, deployment or policy-quality claim

repository_discipline.rationale: Contract first, Config first, owner-layer fixes, backend isolation, and near-risk validation govern the plan.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: G1WalkEnvCfg owns phase lifecycle; Hydra nominal profile owns task semantics; privileged preflight only validates its derived profile.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: One boolean config field changes phase lifecycle while preserving the existing observation tensor surface.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: Privileged config depends on the nominal task profile; the nominal profile has no dependency on FADA runtime or gain logic.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Reset, observation, and action-step ownership are all covered; disabled phase is constant zero across the episode.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: The plan changes one existing G1 state owner and config inheritance boundary without adding a wrapper or service.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Module tests prove semantics and dimensions only; formal runtime, training, and policy quality remain explicit non-claims.

dimensions.name: proof-route
dimensions.evidence: RED owner tests precede implementation, followed by config composition, downstream split regressions, static checks, and final review.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: The two state slots retain shape and position but become constant zeros; command and previous-action axes remain unchanged.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: No model, loss, optimizer, or gradient owner is modified.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Checkpoint schemas remain untouched; nominal artifacts are explicitly excluded from final Oracle lineage and labels.

residual_risks.description: Offline semantic closure cannot prove that dual-Reward SAC learns standing and walking.
residual_risks.disposition: Require formal runtime and policy-quality gates before training claims.
